g.text: Seasonal forecast skill · Screenshot scoring protocol
Centered 3-month means; center leads 1–5; February–June starts; equal event weights. Shading: 5,000 paired-event bootstrap draws.
Strong: 3; moderate: 2; weak: 3 events. Small-sample group results. D20 sLIM, 2002–2024 fit.
